correctness.rationale: Full analytic coarea proof checked: for every level above weighted mean any newly high maximal vertex is adjacent to original high input for n≤5; on cycles this cannot raise connected-component count or perimeter. The level interval between input minimum and weighted mean has input perimeter at least 2 and output perimeter zero. Integration gives a sharp additive deficit; weighted degree-two comparison gives factor 1-w*/W; minimum-mass delta gives equality. Exact-rational script confirms 65,286 nonconstant profiles and 1,620 delta ratios; finite checks are not the proof.

value.rationale: The sharp BV stability constant is fully classified over every positive vertex mass vector for all diameter-two cycles, with an analytically sharp level-set deficit and explicit extremizers. The nearest prior C4 proof requires a casewise finite LP on uniform masses, whereas the new coarea mechanism covers an entire nonlinear continuum of weighted problems and uniquely optimizes observation weights; this is a natural operator question and not a numerical slice.
